source: NASA POWER climatology API v2 (MERRA-2), parameter TS annual (ANN) mean
climatology_period: January 2001 - December 2025 (as reported by the API header)
note: Earth annual mean skin temperature of the analog sites, to be set against lunar south-pole surface temperatures from job J13. Grid cells are about 50 km, so values describe the surroundings, not the exact site.
